organizations.notes: Name is partly illegible in the OCR ('ISU,MIC ABMV'). It is read as Bin Ladin's 'Islamic Army' with low confidence. The source is reported to have advised that a former cabinet minister was selling uranium.

events.description: CIA cable (TOT 182258Z MAR 97) distributed to US agencies reporting on Usama Bin Ladin's attempts to acquire uranium. The cable discusses a report that a former cabinet minister was selling uranium, and that the report should be investigated and the offer on the uranium verified. The text is heavily redacted and garbled.

CIA cable (TOT 182258Z MAR 97) reports Bin Ladin's Islamic Army learned that a former cabinet minister was selling uranium. It advises that the information be investigated and, if true, that contact be made about the offer on the uranium. Large parts of the text are redacted or garbled.
Reported attempt by Bin Ladin's network to acquire uranium, with a cylinder mentioned in a price or product context. The text is fragmentary.

key_claims: A March 1997 CIA cable reports that Usama Bin Ladin sought to acquire uranium.
A report in the cable says a former cabinet minister was selling uranium. The cable says this should be investigated to see if it was true and if the offer was real.
The cable says Bin Ladin was exploring the possibility of mounting operations. The rest of the sentence is illegible.
